title: The 30-Second Damp Skin Rule
tip: Apply hyaluronic acid serums within 30 seconds of cleansing while the stratum corneum is still damp to lock in 3x more cellular moisture.

title: Ceramides Before Nighttime Rest
tip: Trans-epidermal water loss (TEWL) peaks around 2:00 AM. A bio-identical ceramide balm before sleep prevents overnight dehydration.

title: Two-Finger Rule for Indian UV Indices
tip: Measure two full finger lengths of broad-spectrum SPF 50+ to ensure the rated PA++++ protection factor across face and neck.

title: The Retinal Sandwich Technique
tip: If introducing 0.1% Retinal, layer a light moisturizer underneath first, then active retinal, followed by a nourishing night cream.

title: Niacinamide with Zinc Synergy
tip: Applying 10% Niacinamide in the morning regulates pore diameter and reduces mid-day T-zone shine under hot humid weather.
